title: Collect and store using global standards, then analyze
lead: Learning data follows global standards from the moment it arrives, and is stored and analyzed just as it was collected.

steps.title: Standards-based collection
steps.detail: Gathers learning data from all teaching, learning, and operational activities to the same standard.

steps.title: Storage
steps.detail: Stores each learning activity with its context, including the curriculum item where it took place.

steps.title: AI analysis
steps.text: Detects unusual patterns and issues alerts
steps.detail: From accumulated learning data, flags where many learners struggled, in order of priority.

steps.title: Insight
steps.detail: People review the alerts and raw data and make the decision, and the results are recorded as learning data again.

loop.title: Collect · Store · Analyze, in one flow
loop.sub: Learning data collected using global standards is stored in one place and analyzed by AI
